description: The stored keyword research for one product: intent-clustered keyword ideas with volume/difficulty estimates (exact volume + CPC when a Keywords Everywhere key is configured), prioritized content actions, and a per-keyword verdict (own/push/hard/skip). A new run can be triggered from here with run_keyword_research; ideas worth watching can be added to rank tracking with add_tracked_keywords. Requires a plan with the keyword_research facility
name: get_keyword_ideas
